name: Breathing / HRV
instructions: Take a deep breath and center yourself. Stay with rhythm. Notice what's working. Keep it easy. Inhale 4, exhale 6 — 6–8 cycles. Say it: ‘Rhythm before results.’.  End with a calm breath, a soft hand, and note one small win before moving on.
